comparison.objective: Remove an optical instrument from fitted foam, place it on a stand, and collect the inserts safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Supported extraction, careful transfer, and packing-material handling while limiting tilt and descent.
comparison.success_condition: Instrument and inserts placed without drop, excessive tilt, or unsupported descent; the body reports measured controls but not the complete numeric rubric.
comparison.reason: Safe unpacking and transport of a fragile object are different from fine adjustment and repeated physical validation of a damper setting.
